study_identification_part.si4_title: Dissecting task-based fMRI activity using normative modelling: an application to the Emotional Face Matching Task

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The abstract and introduction clearly state the aims: to build large-scale normative models of EFMT task activation to bind heterogeneous datasets to a common reference, dissect heterogeneity beyond group averages, apply to a clinical cohort, and examine associations with transdiagnostic symptom domains.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "We estimate large-scale ( N = 7728) normative models of task-evoked activation... bind heterogeneous datasets to a common reference and dissect heterogeneity... We apply this model to a heterogenous patient cohort ... determine multivariate associations with transdiagnostic symptom domains."; "In this study, we use the Emotional Face Matching Task (EFMT) to demonstrate the potential of the normative modelling method to identify individual differences..."

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: They collated a large reference sample from six datasets (with citations for open data). Image quality standards and exclusion criteria are described (mean relative RMS > 0.5 mm; vmPFC signal coverage filtering in UK Biobank). The final reference sample size is reported (N=7728 overall), and train/test split counts are provided.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "Wecollated a large reference sample from 6 independent sites... AOMIC PIOP2, Duke Neurogenetics Study, HCP Development, HCP Young Adult (1200 release), UK Biobank, and the MIND-Set cohort..."; "Participants were excluded if their mean relative RMS was greater than 0.5 mm. Additional quality control was performed for signal coverage in the prefrontal cortex for the UK Biobank sample..."; "Generalisability was assessed by using a half-split train-test sample (train: 3885, test: 3843)..."; "We estimate large-scale ( N = 7728) normative models..."

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: The normative models explicitly include covariates age and sex, as well as site (dummy-coded), intracranial volume, acquisition parameters (TR, multiband, number of volumes) and task parameters. This addresses both demographic covariates and multi-site effects.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: "We created normative models ... as a function of site, age, sex, intra-cranial volume, and acquisition [TR, multiband sequence, number of volumes...] and task parameters... We included dummy coded site-related variables as additional covariates of no-interest."

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: Per guidance, this study uses existing datasets (SECONDARY data); therefore, detailed acquisition protocol reporting is not required for this item.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: "All data was existing data..."; site-specific protocols are cited rather than newly specified.

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: They describe a harmonized FSL-based preprocessing pipeline and list key steps (gradient unwarping, motion correction, EPI distortion correction, registration, ICA-AROMA denoising, MNI normalization, resampling, smoothing) and note reuse of HCP/UKB pipelines.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: "Data pre-processing was harmonised across all sites; a FSL-based pipeline ... At a within-subject level, all functional data underwent gradient unwarping, motion correction, ... ICA-AROMA, non-linear registration into MNI152 space... resampled to 2mm^3 ... smoothed using a 5 mm FWHM Gaussian kernel."

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: They used a half-split train-test partition to assess generalizability for both contrasts and report the exact sample sizes for each split.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "Generalisability was assessed by using a half-split train-test sample (train: 3885, test: 3843) ... We also created models ... faces condition alone ... (train: 3778, test: 3950 split)."

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: They validated the reference model on an additional, independent set of 5000 UK Biobank participants not used in model development.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "We further validated our reference model with an additional out-of-sample/unseen 5000 participants from UK Biobank."

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: They trained Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) normative models (Gaussian, after comparing warped vs Gaussian), specified covariates, contrasts, and implemented using PCNtoolkit v0.26 in Python 3.8.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: "... by training a Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) model ... In preliminary analyses, we compared a warped model ... focus on the simpler Gaussian model ... This was performed in the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience toolkit (PCNtoolkit) software v0.26 ... implemented in python 3.8."
